name: Cold Spring
title: Hudson River Paddling Conditions Near Cold Spring, NY
blurb: The Hudson Highlands launch most paddlers know: a short carry from the village, Constitution Marsh under the Metro-North trestle just to the south, and Storm King and Breakneck Ridge framing the river.
bannerAlt: The Hudson River seen from a kayak at Cold Spring, looking downriver between Storm King and Breakneck Ridge on a calm morning

tide.label: NOAA 8518934 Beacon − 30 min
tide.note: Tide from NOAA station 8518934 (Beacon), shifted 30 minutes earlier to approximate Cold Spring.
tide.cardNote: Unless you plan on paddling into Constitution Marsh or landing on a beach, tide is likely not very important to you.

current.label: NOAA ACT3726_1 West Point
current.note: Current from NOAA station ACT3726_1 (West Point, off Duck Island), about a mile and a half downriver. Flood and ebb headings are the river’s own axis at Cold Spring.
